approved_architecture_decisions: Use the reviewed Git-installed runtime release phase2-promotion-v5-2687c53 at source commit 2687c534f659e9c2381a961180605b86a1886ac9.
Treat the same Linux user and control-plane account as trusted authority; malicious same-user swap-and-restore during recomputation is outside the threat model.
Fail closed for ordinary authority drift, missing or extra files, symlinks, special files, path escape, size drift, mode drift, and content drift.
Allow host network sharing only for registered real provider launches whose immutable protocol declares provider_access.
Keep canary probes and trusted evaluator execution network isolated and omit provider credentials from evaluator execution.
Mount only the selected Codex 0.145.0 binary, bounded authentication file, sanitized configuration, required system runtime paths, DNS files, and TLS certificates.
Bind the live protocol to model gpt-5.6-sol, medium reasoning, a 600000-token global budget, a 7200-second wall-time budget, and one in-flight provider invocation.
Run P2-08 before P2-09 and P2-10, and require exact current epoch-bound operator authorization before P2-09 may launch any provider.
Use the preregistered deterministic L1 taskpack only in agentteam_direct mode and keep it unavailable to agentteam_full mode.
Do not automatically merge to main or push; P2-10 may only create the reviewed finalization child commit after accepted live evidence and full verification.
resolved_contradictions: Resolved provider reachability versus evaluator isolation by sharing host network only in the provider launch builder while forcing the probe and evaluator builders to remain unshared.
Resolved real Codex binary size versus mount identity bounds by hashing bounded runtime files in streaming form with pre-open, descriptor, and post-read identity checks.
Resolved late authority generation versus frozen taskpack immutability by snapshotting project-work-root authority during materialization and covering snapshots with the frozen digest.

Separated governance commits from evaluated implementation by binding the candidate release and live protocol to commit 2687c53 while requiring that commit to remain an ancestor of the tracked promotion contract.
notes: Approves materialization and freezing of the controller-only P2-08 through P2-10 promotion taskpack. It does not itself provide the separate epoch-bound live-provider authorization required by P2-09, and it does not authorize main-branch merge or push.
